title: O'er Mountain Tops, the Mount of God
description: O'er Mountain Tops, the Mount of God in Tonic Solfa to ST. AGNES, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 811 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “Prospect of Universal Peace”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Metre (8.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to ST. AGNES; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: O'er moun-tain tops, the mount of God, In lat-ter days, shall rise A-bove the sum-mits of the hills, And draw the won-dering eyes.

lines: O'er mountain tops, the mount of God,
Above the summits of the hills,
The beams that shine from Zion's hill
The King who reigns in Salem's towers
Nor war shall rage, nor hostile strife
To ploughshares men shall beat their swords,
They'll lay the martial trumpet by,

licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1853.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to ST. AGNES by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
